title: OverwatchesFullResponseEvent
description: Schema for Service Manager message SM7. This event is published by the Service Manager in response to GetOverwatchesFullCommand and returns the list of registered Overwatch entity references.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be overwatchesFullResponseEvent.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the response event.

messageId.description: Property. Unique identifier of this response message.

correlationId.description: Property. Identifier used to correlate this response event with the corresponding GetOverwatchesFullCommand.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the response event was generated.

overwatches.description: Relationship. List of registered Overwatch entities returned by the Service Manager.
